_comment: Coarse-authorization mappings (x-coaz-mappings) published on this agent's public card, one list per skill id. The Agent Gateway's IBAC engine matches the intent of a prompt (subject type, action, resource type) against them: discovery accepts a skill when any mapping matches any evaluation. Subjects are always Person (every login of the ibac dataset); actions are the KBAC actions of the dataset (ibac-authz skill); resource ids are literal where fixed and left empty otherwise, which matches as a search. A skill without an entry is published without mappings.
